findings.text: the manifest's tests line records the bare pytest invocation while the done_when requires the head run as an all_debug job with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, so the receipt promotion fills from this line cannot be re-run as the measure states; the job identity survives only in logs/head-red-file.log's '# job: qwnw-redfile-head2 on all_debug node 98dci4-clu-3143' header

the artifacts line asserts 'ruff check and ruff format --check clean' on the changed file with no log under logs/, so the done_when's ruff clause is claimed rather than recorded; the claim is true — both commands were re-run against the head version of tests/test_a_hand_written_review_record_is_refused.py and reported 'All checks passed!' and '1 file already formatted' — but no artifact on disk carries that result
